scope: Strict 9 Elements Functions Whitelist & Z-Order Category Deprecation

tasks.title: Deprecate Legacy Z-Index Category & Reclassify Layering Methods
tasks.description: Remove the old 'Z-Order & Layering' / 'Layer Ordering' category from docs-site/src/data/features.json, docs-site/src/data/apiReference.json, README.md, and .agent memory files. Reclassify all layering methods (setZOrder, bringToFront, sendToBack, bringForward, sendBackward) strictly under the unified 'Elements' category alongside element inspection and removal.

tasks.title: Audit, Purge Non-Whitelisted Element Routines & Lock 9-Method Boundary
tasks.description: Audit src/core/PPTXTemplater.js, src/managers/ElementManager.js (or equivalent manager), and index.d.ts. Ensure strictly that only the 9 approved functions (getElements, getElement, removeElement, removeAllElements, setZOrder, bringToFront, sendToBack, bringForward, sendBackward) are exposed for element management and layering. Purge any legacy aliases, deprecated duplicates, or unapproved methods.

tasks.title: Implement Inspection and Removal Subsystem (getElements, getElement, removeElement, removeAllElements)
tasks.description: Implement getElements(slideId) to return complete metadata for all visual objects (shapes, images, videos, audio, tables, charts) under <p:spTree>. Implement getElement(elementId) for single-element inspection. Implement removeElement(elementId) to safely purge any element type from <p:spTree> and clean dangling relationship references in ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels. Implement removeAllElements(slideId) to clear all slide content while preserving layout bindings and required group headers (<p:nvGrpSpPr>, <p:grpSpPr>).

tasks.title: Consolidate Z-Order & Layering Engine under Elements Category
tasks.description: Wire setZOrder(elementId, zIndex), bringToFront(elementId), sendToBack(elementId), bringForward(elementId), and sendBackward(elementId) through PPTXTemplater into src/spatial/ZOrderManager.js. Ensure reordering manipulates child nodes in <p:spTree> without altering required leading group properties (<p:nvGrpSpPr>, <p:grpSpPr>), preventing PresentationML corruption and PowerPoint repair prompts.

tasks.title: Executable Showcase Script (showcase/elements_advanced.js)
tasks.description: Create showcase/elements_advanced.js exercising all 9 approved methods in sequential slide scenarios: retrieving element lists/metadata, adjusting layer positions with setZOrder, bringToFront, sendToBack, bringForward, sendBackward, removing single elements by ID, and clearing entire slide canvases with removeAllElements. Include descriptive console.log diagnostics.

tasks.title: Documentation, TypeScript Typings & .agent Workspace Synchronization
tasks.description: Update docs-site/src/data/apiReference.json with the new 'Elements' category documenting all 9 approved methods with signatures, parameters, return types, and runnable examples. Ensure index.d.ts includes full typings and update .agent/project_summary.md and .agent/rules/features.md to reflect the removal of the old z-order category and addition of the Elements category.
